messages:
Rory (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on sales pipeline, GTM focus, and partner updates. Need a crisp set of owners and measurable KPIs. 10 min Q&A.
Tara - VP Sales: Quick numbers ask: what conversion target should AEs use for pipeline forecasting? current demo->PO is ~8%.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Suggest we set a target of 12% demo->PO for the quarter and measure partner-influenced vs organic separately.
Liam (Partnerships): Pilot partner asks for SAML SSO + weekly usage webhook + a co-branded webinar. Also wants a short case-study approval SLA.
Priya (Legal): We can provide a 5-business-day review SLA for standard case studies; if partner needs early review, please flag. Will draft a short case-study clause for NDAs.
Ana (PM, Product): Eng impact: SAML spike ~2 devs x 7 working days, webhook + events ~3 days QA. Minimal MVP ok. Tag tickets with `g2m-partner-pilot`.
Maya (Finance): Webinar budget note: we can fund up to $25k per co-marketing event for strategic pilots; above that needs central sign-off. Pilot pricing: recommend 15% off time-limited.
Tara - VP Sales: Discount guardrails: AEs approve up to 10% for referral deals; co-sell deals up to 15% if partner brings intro; >15% requires RevOps + Sales Exec approval.
Jamal (Head of Growth): I'll own a partner scorecard: trials started, trial->paid, ARPA uplift, co-marketing ROI. Will post initial template in #growth by Thu.
Liam (Partnerships): Need clarity on attribution params. Growth, can we standardize `partner_id` + `utm_campaign`?
Jamal (Head of Growth): Yes — partner_id + utm_campaign=partner_launch. Also need a weekly CSV webhook schema for downstream analytics.
Ana (PM, Product): Will include partner_id and event schema in the spike ticket. Webhook sample: `{\"event\":\"usage_report\",\"partner_id\":\"p_123\",\"active_users\":42}`
Priya (Legal): I'll attach a short NDA addendum covering co-branded materials and case studies to the partner template.
Rory (CEO): Actions recap: 1) Eng spike for SAML + webhook (Ana). 2) Jamal to publish partner scorecard template. 3) Priya to draft case-study NDA clause and marketing SLA. 4) Finance to confirm co-marketing budget and pilot pricing (Maya). 5) Tara/RevOps to finalize discount bands.
ops-bot: Follow-up meeting created: "GTM Partner Sync" Fri 11:00 AM PT (invites sent).
Maya (Finance): I'll confirm pilot billing/reg recognition and circulate the short note before the sync.
Tara - VP Sales: If any team sees a resource conflict with the estimates, DM me and Rory.
Liam (Partnerships): I'll share partner name via DM per NDA.
Rory (CEO): Thanks all, closing thread. Drop any last items into the calendar invite or #partnerships. :thumbsup:
